title: Passage 22
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: If you get angry many times in a day,
sentences.cn: 如果一天中你会生气很多次，

sentences.en: it is time for you to think about how to deal with it.
sentences.cn: 那就是时候该想想要如何处理这种情绪了。

sentences.en: Here are some of my suggestions.
sentences.cn: 这是我的一些建议。

sentences.en: When you are angry, try to tell yourself through another voice that you are angry and that it is okay.
sentences.cn: 当你生气时，试着用另一种声音告诉自己：你生气了，但是没事。

sentences.en: You don't need to punish yourself for being angry.
sentences.cn: 你不必因为生气而惩罚自己。

sentences.en: It just shows that you have different ideas.
sentences.cn: 生气只是表明你有不同的想法。

sentences.en: Accept that many things are not 100% right or wrong.
sentences.cn: 要接受许多事情并不是百分百正确或错误的。

sentences.en: In our communication with others, the final purpose is not to decide who is right,
sentences.cn: 我们与他人的交流，最终目的不是决定谁是对的，而是要寻找共同之处，并就解决方案达成一致。

sentences.en: but to look for something in common and agree on a solution.
sentences.cn: 我们与他人的交流，最终目的不是决定谁是对的，而是要寻找共同之处，并就解决方案达成一致。

sentences.en: If you still feel strong anger, it is advised that you try going for a jog to let anger out.
sentences.cn: 如果你仍然感到强烈的愤怒，建议你试着去慢跑来发泄愤怒。

sentences.en: Wearing a comfortable cotton blouse can also help you feel more relaxed.
sentences.cn: 穿一件舒适的棉质衬衫也能帮助你感觉更放松。

sentences.en: It's useful to make a promise to yourself to manage anger.
sentences.cn: 对自己做出要管理愤怒的承诺是有用的。

sentences.en: Just like building wealth by saving every cent, small efforts can lead to big improvements.
sentences.cn: 就像通过节省每一分钱来积累财富一样，小的努力可以带来大的改善。

sentences.en: Don't shout or say angry words when you are very angry,
sentences.cn: 不要在非常生气的时候大喊大叫或说气话，因为当你冷静下来时，你可能会后悔说了那些话，事后还可能不得不道歉。

sentences.en: for you will regret saying them when you cool down and may have to say sorry later.
sentences.cn: 不要在非常生气的时候大喊大叫或说气话，因为当你冷静下来时，你可能会后悔说了那些话，事后还可能不得不道歉。

sentences.en: Discussing with a third party is helpful.
sentences.cn: 与第三方讨论是有帮助的。

sentences.en: It is hard for the two parties in anger to understand each other,
sentences.cn: 处于愤怒中的双方很难理解彼此，

sentences.en: but the idea of an outsider can help both parties to get mutual understanding.
sentences.cn: 但局外人的观点可以帮助双方相互理解。

sentences.en: Managing your anger is like letting a horse run in a field,
sentences.cn: 管理你的愤怒就像让马在田野里奔跑，

sentences.en: which means you need to find ways to release the tension.
sentences.cn: 这意味着你需要找到释放紧张的方法。

sentences.en: Anger is just one of the many emotions that make us human.
sentences.cn: 愤怒只是让我们成为人类的众多情绪之一。

sentences.en: And managing it well adds to our ability to truly understand the world.
sentences.cn: 而妥善管理它，能增强我们真正理解世界的能力。
